notes.title: Rotschwert - V1.1 Changelog
notes.content:
Rotschwert V1.1 is now on Steam and it's been almost a day, I hope you've been enjoying your first few visits.

Here is the highlight for some of the noteworthy changes:

New:Segment Select "AlterEgo" is now availableGiven a purpose to an obscure, abandoned spaceStage changes:Segment 1 - orbital +drones section redesigned - bigger drones die instantly when the smaller ones are destroyed, releasing a "bonus" wave afterwardsSegment 1  - extended the mini-tutorial at the start of Relaxed Reverie to give new players more time to adjustSegment 2 - redesigned most of the later patternsSegment 3 - adjusted reflector enemy spawns to prevent unfair damageSegment 4 - sword-wielding enemies' shields are now breakable, making their sections easier to chainSegment ??? - adjusted patterns and bullet visuals to add more variety and make them more readable????????????? - completely redesignedGeneral:Adjustments to enemy sprites, as well as acceleration, backgrounds, and particle effect visualsDirectX related updates - this should fix various graphical glitches with AMD GPUsPerformance improvements - framerates should be higher, especially on weaker machinesText, grammar, font and story correctionsA bunch of small, meaninglessly meaningful things with meaningfully meaningless conditions
Take care, and good luck!

notes.title: Rotschwert V1.1 - Out Now
notes.content:
Rotschwert's Steam release, as well as the V1.1 update, are now out. You may purchase, download and play the game now. Thank you for your patience!

A proper announcement and changelog will be posted after a proper nap. For now - please enjoy my weird little bunny game ːHelen_wink2ː

- Aru

(P.S. - Japanese translation is still WIP and is currently disabled. A separate build will be released as a beta branch within a few days)
